sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of.
1. By way of present application, the petitioner/applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No.08/2020 registered under Sections 376/377 IPC at P.S. Sarai Rohilla, Delhi.
3. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the Status Report.
Let the same be placed on record before the next date of hearing, which shall also indicate the previous involvements of the applicant, if any.
Learned APP further states that the prosecutrix is presently residing at Bapnu Ghar, Bhagwan Das Road, Near Mandi House, Delhi.
4. Learned APP for the State states upon instructions that the prosecutrix prays that a counsel at State expenses may be appointed to represent her in the present matter.
